summary.text: Mary Adams is the Democratic candidate for the North Dakota State Senate, District 43, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican incumbent Jeff Barta.
She previously served in the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 43 from December 2018 to December 2022.

paragraphs.text: Adams was first elected to the North Dakota House of Representatives, District 43, in the November 6, 2018 general election, finishing first among four candidates for two seats.
She took office on December 1, 2018, and served on the House Industry, Business and Labor Committee and the House Political Subdivisions Committee.
She advanced from the Democratic primary for re-election on June 14, 2022, but finished third in the general election for the district's two seats and left office on December 1, 2022.
Adams ran again in 2024 for the North Dakota House of Representatives, District 18, and finished third in the general election for that district's two seats.
In 2026 she advanced from the Democratic primary for State Senate District 43 on June 9, 2026, receiving 589 votes.
